messages.message:
Patch Set 1:

(2 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Looks good: taking oo_guard for write whenever the LMA flags may change does serialize the SA nvlist update, every exit path releases the lock in the mode it was taken, and oo_lma_disk_flags only grows after a successful set or after the flags are seen in the LMA. The optional notes inline don't need a re-spin. If the patch is refreshed, a regression test would help, e.g. several concurrent reads/writes to a newly created encrypted file on a ZFS OST in sanity-sec. Separately, osd-ldiskfs osd_attr_set() has the same pre-existing `oo_lma_flags = attr->la_flags & LUSTRE_LMA_FL_MASKS` overwrite that this patch fixes for ZFS, which could be a follow-up change.

commit.subject: LU-20896 osd-zfs: serialize LMA flag update in osd_attr_set
commit.message:
LU-20896 osd-zfs: serialize LMA flag update in osd_attr_set

Every read and write RPC of an encrypted file passes
LUSTRE_ENCRYPT_FL to osd_attr_set(), which adds it to the LMA xattr
of an object that does not have it yet while holding oo_guard only
for read.  The SA xattr nvlist is not updated atomically, so
concurrent RPCs to a new object race, giving "failed to set LMA
flags: rc = -2" or "rc = -14", and slab corruption or an oops in
nvlist_remove_nvpair() on the OSS.

Take oo_guard for write when osd_attr_set() may update the LMA
flags.  Track the flags known to be on disk separately, since
osd_declare_attr_set() already sets oo_lma_flags, so that only the
first RPCs to an object take the lock for write.  Also keep the other
flags in oo_lma_flags when adding some, as in the LMA.

Fixes: 348446d6370b ("LU-16091 enc: S_ENCRYPTED flag on OST objects for enc files")
